title: Thought spiral support (DBT-informed)
disclaimer: For crisis safety, use your crisis plan or local emergency services. This is a self-help log, not treatment.

spiralStages.label: Trigger (fact)
spiralStages.prompt: What happened first? One sentence, observable.

spiralStages.label: Interpretation / meaning
spiralStages.prompt: What story did your mind add?

spiralStages.label: Body response
spiralStages.prompt: Where do you feel it? What sensations?

spiralStages.label: Urges
spiralStages.prompt: Urges to act (avoid, attack, substance, self-harm, etc.) — rate 0–5.

spiralStages.label: Skills tried
spiralStages.prompt: What you tried and how much it helped (0–5).

de_escalation_skills.name: Check the Facts
steps: What is the emotion and its intensity?
What is the prompting event (facts only)?
Does the emotion fit the facts? If yes, problem-solve; if no, opposite action.

de_escalation_skills.name: TIPP (brief distress tolerance)
steps: Temperature: cool water on face/hands (brief, safe)
Intense exercise briefly if medically appropriate

de_escalation_skills.name: Self-soothe (six senses)
steps: Pick one sense at a time; choose kind, simple inputs (sound, scent, texture, taste, sight, movement).
